name: Feedback Guidance (FBG)
plain: Sets cfg from a running estimate of the posterior that the sample matches the condition, updated each step. Needs a state update after each step.
math:
λ = e^L/(e^L−(1−π)); x̂ = u + λ(c−u) (hybrid adds w−1)
L ← clamp(L − τ/(2s²)(‖x′−μ_c‖²−‖x′−μ_u‖²) + δ, L_min, 3)
